data.paraphrase: For every natural number q, let Nq denote the cardinality of the set {a ∈ ℕ | 0 < a < q/4 ∧ gcd(a, q) = 1}. Then, Nq is odd if and only if there exist natural numbers p and k, with k > 0, such that q = p^k, p is prime, and p modulo 8 is either 5 or 7.
